source.sourceLabel: Archived calculation results for manuscript Figure 3
source.aggregation: 360 interpolation directions × 360 start angles, equally weighted

definitions.sd: Population standard deviation of the 129600 equally weighted integer counts.
definitions.fraction: Observed frequency divided by 129600, retained without rounding.
definitions.window: Bilateral 50% and 10% crossings of the native-z mean of 360 min-max normalized SSPz, with min-max normalization of that mean.
definitions.candidates: Rebinned detector-row centers before interpolation selection or weighting; direct and combined share the finite 460-degree acquired-source/stencil support.
definitions.displaySize: Matplotlib scatter size s = 1 + 95 × fraction in pt². Its circle path has diameter sqrt(s) pt; the 1 pt² floor makes size non-proportional at rare frequencies.

scope: Cached manuscript results. Changing simulator inputs does not change this dataset. Candidate counts do not specify within-window spacing, commercial reconstruction weights, independent measurements, noise or dose.
